plugins.name: soc
plugins.description: Exabeam Agentic SOC plugin (Preview) — Exabeam's agentic SOC skill suite for New-Scale, for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Three skills over one guarded Exabeam MCP bridge: soc-investigate takes an alert or case from first look to a written verdict; triage-cases prioritises the open queue; rule-tuning finds the detection rules wasting analyst attention. Containment is recommended for a human, never executed; dismiss/close is held behind the host agent's approval gate. Blessed build 0.8.6 (2026-09-08), pinned — it does not move until Exabeam moves it.
